title: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. translated_title: AgilePE：通过自我对弈强化学习实现自主无人机追逃
translated_abstract: 自主追逃是无人机（UAV）面临的一项基本挑战，需要在紧密耦合的动态环境和不断变化的对手行为下做出快速决策。传统的基于规则或微分博弈的方法通常难以应对高维空中交互和敏捷机动。我们提出了AgilePE，一个通过自我对弈强化学习实现自主无人机追逃的完整系统。AgilePE在一个统一框架中集成了敏捷低层控制、竞争性策略优化和仿真到现实部署。该策略直接将机载状态观测映射到集体推力和机体速率（CTBR）命令，无需中间轨迹规划器或航点控制器即可实现端到端的敏捷机动。在训练方面，我们使用带有优先级虚构自我对弈（PFSP）和多样化对手池的竞争性自我对弈，使智能体能够针对历史对手不断改进。
tldr: 本文提出了AgilePE，一个通过自我对弈强化学习实现自主无人机追逃的完整系统，该框架将敏捷控制、竞争性策略优化和仿真到现实部署统一起来，实现端到端的敏捷机动。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning, unifying agile control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment for end-to-end agile maneuvering.
